inputs.text: Border czar Tom Homan was on The Charlie Kirk Show this Tuesday and rightly refused to rule out immigration enforcement at polling places. He asked Democrats straight out what they're so afraid of, and that question hits the mark. In a nation built on rule of law and national sovereignty, keeping elections secure from outside influence is basic common sense. The left's resistance and the back-and-forth only shows how little they value personal responsibility or cultural continuity when it comes to protecting American votes and borders. We need this kind of firm authority to maintain order.
